TRIP STYLE

Bottom fishing & combo charters

Fish near the bottom for local targets, or combine supported fisheries in one boat day. A combo depends on time and conditions.

Find this style on the atlas ↗

Who it suits

Anglers who want a boat trip focused on reef, rock or bottom habitat.

Boats & gear

Boat tackle and weights must suit the depth, current and target. Ask what the crew supplies and how the day divides between targets.

Seasons

Species windows and local rules may differ within one trip. Confirm each target and the available boat time.
